about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for backlog N12: `darkroom_nudge` up on `channelmixerrgb.temperature` (colour calibration illuminant, route A) at 7000 K returned `commit_timeout` after ~5 s on both bodies (canary-colorcal-20261108 cov-channelmixerrgb.temperature-{olympus,sony_a7}-nudge_up1). Cause measured on the host (darktable 5.4.1, 2026-11-08): 7000 K is the bauhaus slider's SOFT max (2000..7000 K; the slider's own position query reads 0.0 at 2000, 0.2 at 3000, 0.9 at 6500, 1.0 at 7000/7300/9000/12000), a GUI step does not pass it, while `darkroom_set` 7300 landed. A nudge that cannot move because of a soft bound must answer promptly with a typed noop that names the soft limit and points at set/adjust. Run by tests/intent/test_nudge_soft_limit_intent.py.
subject: scouter/core/darkroom.py nudge + _soft_limit_noop; scouter/core/vocab.py DT_SOFT_BOUNDS
